title: Kyle Hamilton: Think we have a great plan to keep Brazil travel from hindering us

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kyle Hamilton: Think we have a great plan to keep Brazil travel from hindering us
sources.description: There was a lot of focus on travel plans leading into the Week 1 game between the 49ers and Rams in Australia, but there's been less attention paid to the Ravens and Cowboys as they prepare to play in Rio this week.
